queries.query:
from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /lsst.sal.ESS.agcGenset150/)
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.salIndex == 305)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    running: 
      if r.running == true then "Running" else "Stopped",
    engineOilTemperature: r.engineOilTemperature,
    engineHours: r.engineHours,
    multiInput22: r.multiInput22
  }))
  |> keep(columns: [
    "_time",
    "running",
    "engineOilTemperature",
    "engineHours",
    "multiInput22"
  ])
